title: MIDAS：基于互信息解缠与不确定性感知融合的不完整多模态情感分析
summary: 提出MIDAS框架，用于处理不完整多模态情感分析。采用变分建模将各模态表示为多元高斯潜变量，分解为共享和专属因子，通过最小化共享与专属空间互信息实现稳定解缠，最大化跨模态共享空间互信息增强语义对齐。引入不确定性感知融合机制，利用后验方差作为可靠性指标自适应加权，确保模态缺失时鲁棒集成。在三个数据集上显著优于基线。
summary_en: Proposes MIDAS, a unified framework for incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis. It uses variational modeling with multivariate Gaussian latent variables, decomposing into shared and exclusive factors. A minimax objective minimizes mutual information between shared/exclusive spaces for stable disentanglement and maximizes mutual information among shared spaces for semantic alignment. An uncertainty-aware fusion mechanism uses posterior variance as reliability indicator for adaptive weighting. Achieves consistent gains on three datasets.
